teaser: Marconi's deck on journalism as intelligence, built as a working vault: 78 event types, an ontology, 17 observations and a community tracker, all synthetic.
core_idea: Francesco Marconi argues that journalism's advantage moves to how it observes: delta science, an atlas of events with definitions and observable signals, a domain ontology and a persistent record of observations backed by evidence; built here as a vault app that follows his eleven slides on a synthetic data-center buildout, it shows that comparing each new record with the last is where the stories appear, that AI makes observing and comparing cheap while journalists keep the definitions, the checks and the judgement, and that a vault suits an observation desk because the history is versioned, the evidence travels with each claim and the read key opens it.

a single record says little, and the change only appears when it is compared with the last one
The shape is the deck's; the facts are fiction, and the vault says so first.
